sn41.9:1.1: Tena kho pana samayena Acelo Kassapo Macchikāsaṇḍam anuppatto hoti purāṇagihisahāyo || || 3
sn41.9:1.2: Assosi kho Citto gahapati Acelo kira Kassapo Macchikāsaṇḍam anuppatto amhākam purāṇagihisahāyo ti || ||
sn41.9:1.3: Atha kho Citto gahapati yena Acelo Kassapo tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Acelena Kassapena saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn41.9:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārānīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 4 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Citto gahapati Acelaṃ Kassapam etad avoca || ||
sn41.9:1.5: Kīva ciram pabbajito si bhante Kassapāti || ||
sn41.9:1.6: Tiṃsamattāni kho me gahapati vassāni pabbajitassā ti || || 5
sn41.9:1.7: Imehi kho pana te bhante tiṃsamattehi vassehi atthi koci uttarimanussadhammo alam ariyañāṇadassanaviseso adhigato phāsuvihāroti || ||
sn41.9:1.8: Imehi kho me gahapati tiṃsamattehi vassehi pabbajitassa natthi koci uttarimanussadhammā alam ariyañāṇadassanaviseso adhigato phāsuvihāro aññatra naggeyyā ca muṇḍeyyā ca pāvāḷanipphoṭanāya cāti || || 6
sn41.9:1.9: Evaṃ vutte Citto gahapati Acelaṃ Kassapam etad avoca || ||
sn41.9:1.10: Acchariyam vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho
sn41.9:1.11: dhammassa svākhyātatā yatra hi nāma tiṃsamattehi vasehi na koci uttarimanussadhammā alam ariyañāṇadassanaviseso adhigato bhavissati phāsuvihāro aññatra naggeyyā ca muṇḍeyyā ca pāvāḷanipphoṭanāya cāti || || 7
sn41.9:2.1: Tuyham pana gahapati kīva ciram upāsakattam upayatassāti || ||
sn41.9:2.2: Mayham pi kho pana bhante tiṃsamattāni vassāni upāsakattam upagatassā ti || || 8
sn41.9:2.3: Imehi kho pana te gahapati tiṃsamattehi vassehi atthi koci uttarimanussadhammā alam ariyañāṇadassanaviseso adhigato phāsuvihāroti || ||
sn41.9:2.5: Aham hi bhante yāva ākaṅkhāmi vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajam pītisukham pathamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi ||
sn41.9:2.6: ahaṃ hi bhante yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi vitakkavicārānam vūpasamā || pe || dutiyaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharāmi ||
sn41.9:2.7: ahaṃ hi bhante yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi pītiyā ca virāgā || pe || tatiyam jhānam upasampajja viharāmi ||
sn41.9:2.8: ahaṃ hi bhante yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi sukhassa ca pahānā || pe || catutthaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharāmi || ||
sn41.9:2.9: Sace kho panāham bhante Bhagavato pathamataraṃ kālam kareyya anacchariyaṃ kho panetaṃ yam mam Bhagavā etam vyākareyya
sn41.9:2.10: Natthi tam saññojanam yena saññojanena saṃyutto Citto gahapati puna imaṃ lokam āgaccheyyāti || || 9
sn41.9:2.11: Evaṃ vutte Acelo Kassapo Cittaṃ gahapatim etad avoca || ||
sn41.9:2.12: Acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho
sn41.9:2.13: dhammassa svākhyātatā yatrahi nāma gihī odātavasano evarūpam uttarimanussadhammā alam ariyañāṇadassanavisesam adhigamissati phāsuvihāraṃ || ||
sn41.9:2.14: Labheyyāhaṃ gahapati imasmiṃ dhammavinaye pabbajjaṃ labheyyam upasampadanti || || 10
sn41.9:3.1: Atha kho Citto gahapati Acelaṃ Kassapaṃ ādāya yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā there bhikkhū etad avoca ||
sn41.9:3.2: Ayam bhante Acelo Kassapo amhākam purāṇagihīsahāyo ||
sn41.9:3.5: Alattha Acelo Kassapo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye pabbajjam alattha upasampadam ||
sn41.9:3.6: acirūpasampanno ca panāyasmā Kassapo eko vūpakaṭṭho apamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputto sammad eva agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajanti tad anuttaram brahmacariyapariyosānam diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi ||
sn41.9:3.7: Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyam kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi || || 12
sn41.9:3.8: Aññataro ca panāyasmā Kassapo arahatam ahosīti || || 2
